sorted_articles.title: Annual Global IC Fabs And Facilities Report
sorted_articles.summary: 此報告列出的技術論文涵蓋多個電光所核心關注領域，尤其在半導體與先進封裝、AI晶片與運算架構、以及相關材料與製程技術方面。內容包括IGZO FeFETs 3D AI記憶體、單片3D eDRAM、使用單層TMD的奈米帶電晶體，以及半導體製造的虛擬量測等，皆為領先學術機構的尖端研究。這些資訊對於追蹤前瞻技術趨勢與研發方向具高度情報價值。

sorted_articles.title: What Are FeFETs?
sorted_articles.summary: 此篇文章深度探討鐵電場效電晶體 (FeFETs) 技術，特別提及哈夫尼姆氧化物如何突破傳統 FRAM 無法微縮至 130nm 以下的困境，並指引 FeFETs 在 22/28nm 製程節點與 3D 異質 AI 記憶體上的應用。文中引用多篇頂尖研究機構的最新論文，對電光所半導體、AI 晶片與先進記憶體等研發領域具高度技術情報價值。

sorted_articles.title: Chip Industry Week in Review
sorted_articles.summary: 文章指出AI資料中心互連技術將於五年內全面光學化，強調矽光子(SiPho)、InP與共封裝光學(CPO)等關鍵技術，並提及AMD為此收購新創公司。先進封裝技術的製造極限，以及IGZO FeFETs、奈米帶電晶體等半導體元件與製程控制相關研究亦受關注。這些資訊為電光所的光電、半導體與AI運算架構等核心技術發展提供重要的產業趨勢與市場情報。

### Mark LaPedus

(all posts)   
 Mark LaPedus is Executive Editor for manufacturing at Semiconductor Engineering. [...] Müller: Standard FRAM is based on a 1T-1C memory cell in which the ferroelectric film is implemented in the capacitor. FRAM has not scaled beyond the 130nm technology node due to the fact that only planar capacitors can be used and the traditional ferroelectric films are not scalable. This has prevented traditional FRAM from widespread adoption. In comparison, the hafnium oxide based FeFET from FMC is a totally different memory cell in which the ferroelectric actually replaces the gate dielectric of a CMOS transistor. With the ferroelectric film thicknesses thinned down below 5nm, it is therefore scalable to the latest technology nodes. FMC aims for a new wave of ferroelectric memories finally reaching the long-envisioned entry into mass markets.
